name: Curvature-Controlled Style Contours
definition: A contour generation method that regulates contour thickness based on the normal curvature along the view direction to avoid uncontrolled variation in thickness caused by flat vs. fine structures.
summary: Curvature-Controlled Style Contours is a non-photorealistic volume rendering technique that generates outline contours with consistent visual thickness by regulating detection thresholds based on normal curvature along the view direction.
